sentences.l2: 随着城市餐饮消费日益活跃，餐厅里的食物浪费现象也逐渐引起关注。
sentences.l1: As urban dining consumption grows ever more active, food waste in restaurants has also gradually drawn attention.

sentences.l2: 许多顾客在点餐时讲究排场，往往超出实际食量，导致大量菜肴被剩下。
sentences.l1: Many customers care about keeping up appearances when ordering, often exceeding what they can actually eat, so that a lot of dishes are left over.

sentences.l2: 其实，适量点菜、按需取餐，是每个人都能做到的节约方式。
sentences.l1: In fact, ordering a suitable amount and taking food as needed is a way of saving that everyone can practise.

sentences.l2: 近年来，光盘行动倡导人们吃完盘中食物，不随意丢弃，这一理念正被越来越多消费者接受。
sentences.l1: In recent years, the Clean Plate campaign has urged people to finish the food on their plates and not discard it carelessly, an idea that is being accepted by more and more consumers.

sentences.l2: 对于确实吃不完的饭菜，主动打包既方便又务实，可以减少不必要的损失。
sentences.l1: For food that really cannot be finished, taking it away in a box on one's own initiative is both convenient and practical, and can reduce unnecessary loss.

sentences.l2: 餐厅方面也在调整经营思路，通过推出小份菜、半份菜和提醒服务，帮助顾客控制份量。
sentences.l1: Restaurants are also adjusting their operating approach, helping customers control portions by introducing small dishes, half dishes and reminder services.

sentences.l2: 节约粮食不仅关系到个人消费习惯，也体现着对劳动成果的尊重和对社会资源的珍惜。
sentences.l1: Saving grain is related not only to personal consumption habits, but also reflects respect for the fruits of labour and cherishing of social resources.

sentences.l2: 当越来越多的人把光盘行动融入日常用餐，餐厅浪费现象有望得到更有效的改善。
sentences.l1: When more and more people bring the Clean Plate campaign into their everyday meals, restaurant waste is expected to be improved more effectively.
